title: scripts/abi-v1/build-stubs.sh's stubs.json manifest, format 1
description: What build-stubs.sh writes alongside the compiled stub libraries it builds, one row per scripts/abi-v1/emit/_stubshared.py plan() entry. Never committed (a build-time file, like the libraries themselves); a future binding conformance runner reads it to find each library's path, the predicate to load it under, and the loader-refusal reason (spec/abi-v1/sdk.json's vocabulary, or "accepted") its own loader test should see.

predicate.description: The build_info-shaped predicate this variant should be loaded under: byte-for-byte the 'ok' build's own fields, except ctor-marker (glibc_floor overridden to an impossible value, to prove a loader's step 1 refuses before ever calling dlopen).

reason.description: "accepted", or one of spec/abi-v1/sdk.json's loader.refusals reasons (a missing_symbol:<name> or build_info_mismatch:<field> reason carries its suffix).
